findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: thread, mentions, search · Private data: member, invoice, claim_invoice, recover_pass, me, set_profile, board, thread, post_thread, reply, mark_useful, flag, mentions, news, feed, search · Public sink: post_thread, mark_useful, flag, feed · Destructive: recover_pass.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: thread, mentions, search · Private data: member, invoice, claim_invoice, recover_pass, me, set_profile, board, thread, post_thread, reply, mark_useful, flag, mentions, news, feed, search · Public sink: post_thread, mark_useful, flag, feed · Destructive: recover_pass

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
